newsitem.title: USA: EIS International to take Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: EIS International to take Q1 charge.

text.p: EIS International Inc said Monday that it expects to take a charge of about $3 million for downsizing its subsidiary, Cybernetics Systems International Corp, integrating Pulse Technologies Inc with the core business and closing the Pittsburgh corporate facility.
EIS reported a fourth quarter loss of $1.72 a share, compared to profit of $0.24 a share the rpevious fourth quarter.

The 1996 fourth quarter results included a $17.0 million charge related to the operating losses and the write-down of assets associated with the 1996 acquisition of Cybernetics Systems International Corp.
The 1996 fourth quarter also included a $1.1 million charge from the discontinuance of the operations of Surefind Information, a subsidiary in the on-line data backup and recovery business.
